idea_units.text: An ablation study is planned to prove the necessity of combining short-term and long-term memory, comparing a RAG-only baseline, a short-term only system, a long-term only system, and the full system.
In the ablation study, the working memory component will be a constant, always active and receiving input across all tested configurations to simulate an ongoing conversation.

The primary difference between the RAG baseline and the proposed system is data organization; RAG performs direct semantic vector search, while the proposed system first structures the transcript into idea units.

In contrast to the simple RAG baseline which just chunks text for semantic search, the Full System structures content into idea units, generates higher-level conclusions on top of these units for broader context, and includes a more detailed short-term memory component to track recent conversational activities.
